note: This contract adds an explicit, versioned V2 cutoff-context vector alongside the unmodified v1 canonical representation. It never replaces or mutates configs/synthetic/feature_schema_v2.json, src/data/xgb_canonical.py's flat feature map, or src/preprocess/synthetic_phase10.py.

current_sofa_semantic_contract.verified_definition: SOFA scored exactly at prediction_time t -- src/labels/recovery.py:build_recovery_label computes `baseline = _checked_score(score_at(prediction_time), prediction_time, stay_id)`.

B_MIN.description: elapsed_episode_hours_at_t + current_sofa_at_t only; removes exact linear redundancy among the three elapsed-time representations

B_PLUS_F.description: B_FULL plus the exact eight Phase-1 Group-F support-history features; no new F features invented

complexity_tie_break.rule: never choose the simpler representation when it materially performs worse

gru_architecture_note.decision: The V2 context vector is train-only normalized then concatenated into the existing GRUEncoder's static_features input (static_dim = 8 original statics + variant context_feature_count), reusing GRUEncoder/CanonicalBatch/ICUTimeGRU/RecoveryGRU unchanged. This satisfies 'recurrent temporal representation + transformed static representation + transformed V2 context representation -> concatenate -> existing task head' without adding a new dataclass field to the frozen CanonicalBatch contract or a new encoder module -- the context values are already the 'transformed' (normalized) representation being concatenated.
